text:
maria: quick question — docs wants the console to show why we chose a model variant during requests, esp when a dedicated tenant spills to hosted. need a short plan (UX + telemetry) by EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sara: do we want to show the raw routing reason (e.g. \"dedicated_capacity_exhausted\") or a translated explanation (\"using hosted fallback due to capacity\")?
kevin: ops wants an audit-safe field. raw_code + human_reason might be best: `routing_code` and `routing_hint`. `routing_code` should be machine-only in logs, `routing_hint` user-facing.
maria: agreed. also legal asked that nothing with customer payload/inputs be exposed in hosted fallback logs for privacy. that affects what we surface in the console trace.
chris: UX idea — show a small badge next to the model name: \"fallback\" with hover text for `routing_hint`. clicking it opens the audit panel with `routing_code` + timestamp (restricted to admin roles).
kevin: telemetry note: we already emit `routing_decision` in the request envelope, but sampling is 5%; for fallbacks we should upsample to 100% for first 30s after a capacity event so we can debug regressions quickly. we should also tag sampled events with `variant_compat` booleans.
sara: is there an existing opt-in flag for tenants to allow their hosted-fallback traces to be recorded? some customers insisted on strict isolation.
maria: no global opt-in today. we need a per-tenant consent flag exposed in the Console: `allow_spillover_traces` (default: off for dedicated contracts).
kevin: adding consent changes routing behavior tied to SLA — must not silently enable. If `allow_spillover_traces=false` we must redact sensitive parts before sending to hosted. minimal payload only: `request_id`, `routing_code`, `model_variant` (no prompt).
chris: on the console, adding the toggle is straightforward. but we should surface consequences inline: \"Disabling traces hides detailed fallback reasons; support may need additional logs to debug.\"
telemetry-bot: note from telemetry infra: adding a new `routing_reason_v2` field is fine. we recommend naming: `routing_reason` (human), `routing_code` (enum), `routing_trace_id` (opaque). all strings, indexed.
kevin: API shape proposal (internal only):
```json
{
  "routing_code": "DEDICATED_FULL",
  "routing_hint": "Using hosted fallback due to reserved GPU exhaustion",
  "routing_trace_id": "rt-78a3f",
  "variant_id": "rw-v2-q8_0",
  "variant_compat": "best_effort"
}
```
maria: for redaction when `allow_spillover_traces=false`, we'd send only:
```json
{
  "routing_code": "DEDICATED_FULL",
  "routing_trace_id": "rt-78a3f",
  "variant_masked": "rw-v2-*****"
}
```
sara: does masking variants like that meet legal? need confirmation. also we should log an audit entry whenever the toggle is flipped (actor + timestamp).
kevin: agree on audit log for toggle changes. also recommend an alert rule: if >1% of a tenant's requests fall back in 5m, page platform-eng and account manager.
chris: UX: where to show the `routing_hint`? Proposal: request detail flyout, small timeline showing: queued -> routed -> served, with the routing badge at routed. click badge -> drawer with `routing_hint` + link to raw audit (if allowed).
maria: rollouts: implement backend fields + telemetry sampling first, behind `console_feature: model_routing_explain` flag. then enable toggle in console next week for a small subset of tenants.
kevin: implementation detail: backend will write `routing_code` into Kinesis stream, and a new consumer will enrich with capacity events to produce `routing_hint`. this avoids leaking capacity signals directly.
telemetry-bot: added task: create new stream `routing_decisions_v2` and ensure retention 30d. sampling override for fallback events must be config-driven: `fallback_upsample_window_seconds` (default 30).
chris: can we add a short inline copy for the console toggle: \"Allow Redwood to record non-payload routing traces when your Dedicated capacity overflows — required to see detailed fallback reasons. Turn off to minimize any hosted trace data.\"
maria: yes, add that and a link to the privacy/terms doc. also add a small banner when fallback rate >0.5%: \"Tenant fallback detected — detailed traces currently OFF for this tenant. Enable to debug.\"
kevin: one more thing: when we select a hosted variant with lower quality (quantized variant), we should annotate `quality_delta_estimate` in telemetry (coarse bucket: low/medium/high). don't include score or logprob distributions.
sara: sounds good. legal asked for a one-liner on retention and access group for routing_decisions_v2. telemetry-bot, can you set retention to 30d and make access group `platform-audit`?
telemetry-bot: done — retention=30d, access_group=platform-audit. created ACL ticket #PLAT-4812.
maria: plan summary: (1) add routing fields v2 to envelope + sampling rules (kevin) (2) console toggle + UX (chris) (3) opt-in/consent semantics + audit logs (sara) (4) rollout behind `model_routing_explain` (maria) -> target: staged by next Tuesday.
chris: I'll draft the UI copy and mock in Figma, pinging you all when ready.
kevin: I'll add the Kinesis stream and sampling override, and a small lambda to redact when consent=false.
sara: I'll coordinate with legal on the redaction language and confirm the variant masking approach.
maria: thanks everyone. quick follow-ups: can folks add short PR checklists in the planning ticket? I'll file the ticket now. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: feature-flag `model_routing_explain` will be created in staging at 2026-03-21T02:00Z.
maria: perfect — will review tomorrow morning.
